result.question: What sign does the man of God give?

readings.answer: That the altar will be split apart and its ashes will be poured out.
readings.support: Surely the altar will be split apart, and the ashes upon it will be poured out.

assessments.reason: The answer directly restates 13:3: “Surely the altar will be split apart, and the ashes upon it will be poured out,” matching the key.

result.reason: Verse 13:3 explicitly gives the sign that the altar will split and its ashes will pour out, which the reading states.
